## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmation: (1) broad sector dispersion with Energy/Materials/Industrials leading while Technology and Communication are lagging, (2) major-cap divergences among megacaps (Big Tech mixed vs cyclicals strong). Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +5.59% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +5.71% | 1M: +27.25%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: DOW (1W: +7.01% | 1M: +23.31%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials solid: DE (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +14.33%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -9.02%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -5.64% | 1M: -8.24%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -14.04% | 1M: -3.16%) BELOW TREND. Communication weak: NFLX (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -9.19%) BELOW TREND. Financials slightly soft: WFC (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -5.86%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +14.72% | 1M: +49.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.05% | 1M: +24.24%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +7.01% | 1M: +23.31%) ABOVE TREND, PNC (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +6.68% | 1M: +28.30%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -14.04% | 1M: -3.16%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -13.28% | 1M: -21.38%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -9.33% | 1M: -18.31%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -14.07%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -5.64% | 1M: -8.24%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in large-cap software/enterprise names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +14.72% | 1M: +49.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.05% | 1M: +24.24%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +6.68% | 1M: +28.30%) ABOVE TREND — watch for MAJOR divergence: NVDA (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +5.27%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: -2.26% | 1M: +8.57%) RECOVERY, AMZN (1W: -4.65% | 1M: +2.01%) RECOVERY indicate tactical rotation, not confirmed market leadership.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed-to-weak; large-cap software/enterprise under pressure while select hardware/semis lead. AAPL (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -9.02%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -5.64% | 1M: -8.24%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +5.27%) RECOVERY — Tech: 6/19 positive (internal weakness).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Mixed and slightly negative on the week with pockets of strength. PNC (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND vs JPM (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -3.07%) BELOW TREND — Financials: 8/20 positive (internal rotation).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Defensive support with constructive breadth; development catalysts in play. JNJ (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +4.66%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +0.12% | 1M: +2.05%) ABOVE TREND — Healthcare: 11/15 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals/value exposure while monitoring tech reversion risk; rotate toward XOM (1W: +5.59% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +7.01% | 1M: +23.31%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND and reduce exposure to large-cap software names showing sustained BELOW TREND readings (AAPL, MSFT, ORCL). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — trade selectively.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: LLY (1W: +0.12% | 1M: +2.05%) ABOVE TREND — FDA breakthrough catalyst; AMAT (1W: +6.68% | 1M: +28.30%) ABOVE TREND — analyst uplift; XOM (1W: +5.59% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND — energy strength.  
BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -14.04% | 1M: -3.16%) BELOW TREND — legal/AI funding headline; NFLX (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -9.19%) BELOW TREND — earnings disappointment; MSFT (1W: -5.64% | 1M: -8.24%) BELOW TREND — watch downside follow-through.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (XOM/CVX/SLB) — sector strength confirmed, Energy: 6/8 positive. BEARISH: Technology and Communication — Tech: 6/19 positive, Communication weak with NFLX under pressure.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +5.27%) RECOVERY — watch for 1W to flip positive for confirmation of semiconductor leadership. AAPL (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -9.02%) BELOW TREND — failure to stabilize this week increases downside risk. XOM (1W: +5.59% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND — hold of weekly gains signals continuation in Energy.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
LLY (+80): FDA Grants Breakthrough Therapy tag — LLY (1W: +0.12% | 1M: +2.05%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. AMGN (+55): Pipeline momentum — AMGN (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. AMAT (+50): KeyBanc target lift — AMAT (1W: +6.68% | 1M: +28.30%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ORCL (-60): AI funding-model lawsuit — ORCL (1W: -14.04% | 1M: -3.16%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed and price accelerating lower. NFLX (-55): Disappointing earnings narrative — NFLX (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -9.19%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. JNJ (-55): guidance concerns — JNJ (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +4.66%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment diverging — watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. INTC (1W: +14.72% | 1M: +49.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +6.68% | 1M: +28.30%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +5.59% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is major-cap divergence — NVDA/GOOGL/AMZN in RECOVERY while AAPL/MSFT/ORCL remain BELOW TREND, so monitor earnings/news flow and sentiment-confirmation closely.
